item.title: Councillors say civic offices will see investment not destruction
item.description: Civic chiefs in Fareham have said their offices are here to stay after a councillor asked a public meeting if it could be knocked down.

item.title: Man, 59, who died after choking in supermarket car park named as inquest opens
item.description: An inquest has opened into the death of a Southampton man who died in a supermarket car park.

item.title: Residents urged to be vigilant after reports of taxi scam in Bursledon
item.description: Residents in Bursledon are being warned to stay alert following reports of suspected fraudulent activity involving a man asking for money.

item.title: Liberal Democrat councillor resigns 15 months after by-election win
item.description: A councillor in Southampton has resigned with immediate effect 15 months after being elected.

item.title: City bar closed due to 'far-right asylum seekers protests', says campaign group
item.description: Stand Up To Racism have blamed the closure of a popular Portswood bar on constant protests from the Southampton Patriots over asylum seekers.

item.title: The personal training team who will make you feel ten years younger
item.description: It's business as usual at Focused Personal Training, despite the turn of the year. They're all about lifelong fitness, not new year new you fads.

item.title: Hour-by-hour forecast as Storm Goretti hits Southampton
item.description: Storm Goretti has hit Southampton overnight - here's the Met Office hour-by-hour forecast for today.

item.title: New store to open in Westquay this month with gift for first customers
item.description: Pop Mart is opening its 13th UK store at Westquay Shopping Centre in Southampton on January 16, 2026.

item.title: Appeal lodged over refusal to demolish 600-year-old Swanmore cottage
item.description: An appeal has been formally lodged against the refusal to demolish one of Swanmore’s oldest cottages, reigniting a bitter planning dispute that previously sparked a huge public backlash.

item.title: Grandmother's shock at finding cement mixer driven into her garage
item.description: A grandmother has described her shock at seeing a cement mixer had driven into her garage building
